status: FROZEN before any S7-1 answer generation - approved by project owner
source: eval/stage5_questions.json (Stage 5 development set); the Stage 6 held-out set is not used

excluded.N3: used as the S7-0 live connectivity question; its answers have been seen

rationale.N1: list answer; first sufficient evidence at rank 2; both yearbooks
rationale.N7: only sufficient chunk at rank 4 behind distractors
rationale.E3: bare-code query form; known conflicting titles for SEMA204 (general conflicting-evidence rule only)
rationale.E4: lowercase 'what is' query form; Sciences yearbook
rationale.E5: 'tell me about the module' query form; Humanities yearbook
rationale.E6: 'what is ... about' query form; Sciences yearbook
rationale.C1: description question with user-supplied context the evidence does not confirm
rationale.C5: programme-table credit question; known table weakness (sufficient at rank 4)
rationale.C8: yes/no question containing a premise; single evidence chunk
rationale.C9: list answer from a programme table; sufficient at rank 2
rationale.C10: description question; known conflicting titles for BM135 (general conflicting-evidence rule only)

representativeness.note: This subset is somewhat harder than the complete Stage 5 in-scope pool, and conflict cases are intentionally overrepresented.
representativeness.evidence_chunks: natural-language questions always have 5; code questions mostly 2 (E3: 3; C8: 1; C5, C10: 5) - the accepted Stage 6 code-aware behaviour

r1_ambiguity: The S6-5 ambiguity metadata is not introduced in S7-1. R1 ambiguity-aware answer behaviour is deferred to S7-4. E3 and C10 exercise only the general conflicting-evidence rule; they are not an evaluation of the S6-5 ambiguity metadata.
